Name: Free Chest Organization
Author: Smlv04
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

[size=4]Tired of the game automatically moving all your items to the top of your chest every time you store them? Free Chest Organization completely revolutionizes your inventory management. It disables the default auto-compression feature to give you total control over your storage (just like in the Android version) and introduces new item transfer mechanics inspired by Minecraft.

By safely bypassing the game's native compacting feature, you can leave empty spaces between your tools, crops, and materials, creating static and visually appealing inventory layouts. Place your sword in the bottom right corner, your pickaxe in the top left, and leave the center completely empty—it'll stay exactly where you put it![/size]


[b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Main features[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Absolute freedom in the chest:[/b][/size][size=3] Place any item in any slot. The game will no longer force items to automatically compact to the top.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Static layouts:[/b][/size][size=3] Your items stay exactly where you placed them, even after closing and reopening the chest. Perfect for creating visual sorting systems.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b][size=4]Smart Shift-click:[/size][/b][size=3] Shift-clicking on items works flawlessly! The mod intelligently merges existing stacks or fills the first available empty slot without disrupting your custom layout.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Double-click collection:[/b][/size][size=3] Double-click any item to instantly group all identical items scattered throughout the chest and your inventory into a single stack.[/size][/color]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3kg8zpq.gif[/img]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Right-click drag (Paint/Vacuum):[/b][/size][size=3] Hold down the right mouse button while pointing at a slot. If your cursor is empty, you'll "suck" the items from that slot into your hand. If you have a stack in your hand and drag the cursor across multiple slots, you'll "paint" (distribute) one item per slot seamlessly.[/size][/color]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HGZsvgX.gif[/img]

[b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Quick Transfers:[/size][/color][/b][size=3][color=#d4d4d8] Hold down the configured modifier key (Left Control by default) + Left-Click to instantly transfer a single item. Keep holding both buttons over a stack to rapidly transfer items one by one like a machine gun, without needing to spam click![/color][/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KEcHDdt.gif[/img]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Configuration:[/size][/b] Custom Minecraft-style controls can be easily enabled or disabled via the Generic Mod Config Menu to suit your play style.[/color]


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]

[size=4]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url].[/size]


[size=5][b]Changelog[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Bug Fix:[/b][/size] Fixed an issue where the mod's right-click mechanics prevented players from attaching bait/tackle to fishing rods and loading ammunition into slingshots.
